# tfcensus cache

tfcensus keeps two caches under $XDG\_CACHE\_HOME/tfcensus:

```text
probe  doctor's and scan's capability probe, one file per account and region, fresh for 24h
scan   scan's inventory and state index, one file per set of inputs, fresh for cache.ttl (1h)
```

They hold identifiers, tags and probe results, never state attribute values. doctor --refresh
and scan --refresh ignore them for one run.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus cache <command>
```

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus cache info
tfcensus cache clear
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [tfcensus cache clear](/cli/cache/clear) | Delete every entry of both caches |
| [tfcensus cache info](/cli/cache/info) | Show each cache's directory, entry count, size and freshness |
